marta: Heads-up — onboarding run for hf/llamaX-7B-int8 on staging shows a weird class of failures when we exercise multi-step toolchains (retrieval -> summarize -> call-external-tool).
raj: saw some of that in the smoke logs. Are failures parse errors (malformed JSON) or missing fields?
oliver: mostly malformed JSON plus odd extra text after the JSON object. looks like partial generation + trailing commentary.
ci-bot: [CI] toolchain-schema-audit #482 FAILED — 18/120 examples failed parsing. logs: https://ci.internal/482
marta: sample from failing run: ```{
  \"actions\": [
    {\"type\": \"search\", \"query\": \"redis clustering guide\"}
  ],
  \"result\": \"Found a good guide at ...\"}
followed by:
Sorry, I can also add ...
```
raj: that trailing "Sorry..." is the problem. The JSON is correct then human-ish text appended. probably greedy decoding or stop token mismatch.
yang: could be quantization-induced tokenization misalignment too — int8 can shift distribution, causes longer drift after model emits complete JSON closing braces.
sam: quick experiments: 1) enforce strict stop tokens after `}` 2) decode with top_p 0.95 -> top_k 40 3) try fp16 variant as baseline.
oliver: also add a post-output sanitizer that slices out last JSON object using a regex fallback before parse. naive regex: ```/\{[^]*\}\s*$/s``` but be careful.
raj: we should run an A/B on the eval set: run 5k toolcall prompts on fp16 baseline, int8 current, and int8 with stop-token+rescue enabled. measure parse success, schema compliance (required fields present), and semantic correctness.
yang: assign me to rerun quant calibration with larger calibration set (10k) — that reduced hallucination in earlier runs. also add kv-cache disabled run to rule out batching side effects.
marta: action items: raj run the A/B benchmarks and post numbers by EOD Monday; oliver add runtime schema-gate + rescue hook; yang redo quant calibrations and report delta; sam add a small unit test for trailing-text sanitizer.
raj: noted. I'll also dump token-level logits for failing examples to look for distribution shift.
marta: thanks. low priority: add an eval column for "post-rescue semantics changed" so we can detect when repair changes meaning.
ci-bot: [note] created issue #912: "toolcall-schema-rescue-and-quantization-eval" and linked this thread.
oliver: one more: consider a lightweight LM-based repair step (prompt: "extract JSON object only") run at the end when regex fails — cheaper than re-decoding whole sample. could be good fallback for hosted customers.
sam: agreed. small cost but likely reduces support tickets. :thumbsup:
marta: cool. i'll synthesize a test plan and post in the repo (tests/toolcall-schema/). thanks everyone.
